title: Prescribed Fourier kernel
statement: For a finite family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and a point $a\in\{-1,1\}^n$, define a function on the Boolean cube by $K_{\mathcal F,a}(x)=\dfrac{2^n}{|\mathcal F|}\,P_{\mathcal F}(a,x)$, where $P_{\mathcal F}$ is the singleton-indicator Fourier projection associated with $\mathcal F$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$
$a$ is a point of the Boolean cube
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the singleton-indicator Fourier projection, so its precise meaning cannot be rendered from the provided context.
